26. ESTABLISH – NO STOPPING ANY TIME, EXCEPT BICYCLES
ESTABLISH – BIKE SHARE STATION
West Portal Avenue, east side, from 5 feet to 46 feet north of Ulloa Street (41-foot station)
(Supervisor District 7) (Approvable by the City Traffic Engineer) 

Proposal to install a Bay Wheels bike share station in the “horseshoe” of the West Portal Muni station,
alongside the Muni tracks, where City maintenance vehicles currently park.

Public Comments: Received emails in support prior to public hearing. Similar comment received
during public hearing.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
